measured_by: sub-agent self-report (four fresh general-purpose sub-agents, one per job); no transcripts were captured, so cli_errors, source_reads and guessed_params are not measured

jobs.request: hulg uk,hk ljpv; ggvdg. fhsl hg,v]m hgplvhx
jobs.outcome_note: stopped at the write gate (exit 3); no --approve-write given, as the test rules required
friction: USE.md gives no example of the approval step for a request that says 'اعمل'.
Passing Arabic text unquoted in PowerShell split on spaces and failed with 'not a key=value parameter'; the whole key=value had to be wrapped in single quotes. USE.md does not mention this.
start reports a default private database path when RED_ROSE_DB is not set. The sub-agent did not open it, but USE.md does not warn about it.
brief decoded the keystrokes to the Arabic title with route title-frame-ar (sub-agent reports score 73.7); the decode was checked only from the fixes list, not by reading each keystroke.

jobs.request: عايز اطابق كشف حساب البنك مع الدفتر وطلعلي الفروقات  [مرفق: bank.csv, ledger.csv]
jobs.outcome_note: attachments were not reachable from the temp folder, so the required inputs were missing; recipe exited 1 with missing[]
friction: USE.md uses a <skill folder> placeholder; the sub-agent took the real path from start's output.
USE.md gives no CSV header schema for bank-reconcile (column names, reference column). The owner's file layout could not be checked.
start reports the default private database path; the sub-agent set RED_ROSE_DB to a temp file. USE.md does not mention that variable.
The sub-agent ran with -B to avoid writing __pycache__ into the skill folder; USE.md does not say whether running the script writes bytecode there.
brief asked for the two CSV paths as must_ask and gave route bank-reconcile with date_window_days assumed to be 3.

jobs.outcome_note: no source file in the request, so the only permitted step was to ask; the test rule said ask nothing, so the sub-agent stopped
friction: brief returned decision ask with one missing item (the video path), which is the intended behaviour.
Running shot-report-recut without a source exits 1 with missing[]; the non-zero exit reads as an error even though nothing broke.
The test rule 'ask nothing' conflicts with the skill's rule to ask the owner for missing inputs; the sub-agent followed the test rule and stopped.

jobs.request: حط كابشن على الريل ده بكلامي بالظبط من غير ما تغير ولا كلمه  [مرفق: reel.mp4, words.json]
jobs.first_command: $work = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("rr-job4-" + guid); New-Item ...; python -X utf8 "<red-rose>\rose.py" start
jobs.outcome_note: words.json and reel.mp4 were not in the temp folder, so no caption text existed; the sub-agent refused to invent text
friction: USE.md uses a <skill folder> placeholder; the real path came from start's output and was reused by hand.
captions-from-words without words exits 1 with status 'ready' and outcome 'error'. The status and outcome read inconsistently, although missing[] lists the needed input with an Arabic question.
brief returned decision ask on the words file; the first_reply_ar describes a caption render that cannot happen without it.

summary.note: all four jobs stopped before a deliverable. Input files were not provided in the test folders, and two jobs were blocked by the write gate or the ask-once rule, which is the intended behaviour. No job tested the render or verify path end to end.
